Container.Name: access-window-mediamtx
Container.Overview:
MediaMTX - pulls RTSP from your UniFi Protect cameras and re-publishes as HLS for Access Window. Put this on the same custom Docker network as access-window-api so the API can reach it by name for auth checks and health polling.
Edit the mounted config file directly to add your cameras' real RTSP sources.
Container.Requires: Nothing - but access-window-api needs to reach this container by name, so add it to that container first, or plan the shared network before adding either.

Config.Name: HLS Port
Config.Description: HLS output - point your NPMPlus /hls/ proxy location here

Config.Name: Config File
Config.Description: Your mediamtx.yml with real camera RTSP sources - see the repo's mediamtx/mediamtx.yml for the template
